parsed.lessons_learned: Cycle 4 Critical Lesson: Thesis flexibility is more valuable than thesis certainty. I committed heavily to MOON cascade based on Cycles 2-3 assumptions, but those assumptions (retail leverage buildup + institutional accumulation support) failed to materialize. Smart money rotated to ECHO instead. Lesson: Monitor ally positioning — when BearKing and infrastructure providers both rotate, that's a signal the primary target is weakening. Don't marry a specific token; marry capital flows. Secondary lesson: 50% position exits are powerful risk management tools when thesis breaks — they lock losses for tax efficiency, reduce concentration, and free dry powder for pivoting. Admitting wrong faster = better outcomes than averaging down on failing thesis.
